jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🖥️ VIRTUAL DRIVE – Direct Interview on Google Meet | 24 Nov, 12:30–2:00 PM IST

Quick answer: Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 lets you attend a direct interview online on Google Meet, 24 Nov 2026, 12:30–2:00 PM IST for the Talent Acquisition Intern role in Noida. Register on the Google Form first; no office visit is needed. Info Edge, the company behind Naukri.com, wants MBA/PGDM candidates with 0–1 year of experience for a 6-month intern/contract job that can turn full-time. The Naukri listing shows ₹3–4 LPA and 3 openings.

Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 — job details at a glance Company Info Edge (India) Ltd – parent of Naukri.com Role Talent Acquisition Intern (Non-IT Recruiter) Drive date & time 24 Nov 2026, 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM IST Interview mode Direct interview online – Google Meet Job location Noida (work mode not stated) Salary / stipend Official: ₹3–4 LPA (Naukri) | Reported: ₹1.4–8 LPA, Info Edge interns, all roles (AmbitionBox, 4 reports) Experience 0–1 year (recruitment internship preferred) Education MBA/PGDM, any specialisation Duration 6-month intern/contract; full-time conversion on performance Openings 3 | Batch: Not stated 🎥 Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 – Direct Interview details Virtual Drive – attend a direct interview online on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 📍 Drive type Virtual Drive – direct online interview 📅 Interview date 24 November 2026 (Tuesday) ⏰ Timing 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM IST 💻 Platform Google Meet (browser or Meet app) 🆔 Meeting code yhn-hgii-tck 🔗 Meeting link https://meet.google.com/yhn-hgii-tck 📝 Registration form https://forms.gle/yNp8DbnmGPB4yBhq5 Fill in the registration form, then join the Google Meet at 12:30 PM IST with your resume ready and attend the direct interview online.

Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 – full job details

The Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 is a same-day virtual drive for a non-IT recruitment internship, where candidates attend a direct interview online. You register through a short Google Form the recruiter added to the listing, then face the interview on one Google Meet call inside a 90-minute window. Nothing happens in person for this round.

The role offered in the Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 sits in the Human Resources team and is built around volume hiring for sales and other non-technical jobs. Naukri lists it in Noida with three openings, a 0–1 year experience band and a temporary/contractual employment type. After six months, Info Edge says the intern may be moved to a full-time role if performance is good.

Online direct interview: the whole round runs on Google Meet, so you do not need to visit any office.

Check before you join: the ₹3–4 LPA figure sits on a 6-month intern/contract role – ask the recruiter whether it is the internship pay or the package after conversion.

Education filter: the only qualification listed is an MBA/PGDM in any specialisation. Graduates without a postgraduate degree are not mentioned as eligible.

What you will do in the Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 role

  • Find candidates for non-IT openings through job portals, social media and employee referrals
  • Call about 100–120 candidates a day on a dialer and screen them over the phone
  • Run phone and face-to-face interviews to judge skills and fit
  • Work with hiring managers to understand each opening and what the team needs
  • Drive each requirement from the job post up to offer discussion
  • Record every step in the applicant tracking system (ATS) so records stay complete

Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 eligibility

  • Education: MBA/PGDM, any specialisation (as listed on Naukri)
  • Experience: 0–1 year; earlier recruitment work or an HR internship is asked for
  • Skills: clear spoken communication, interviewing, judging skill set and culture fit, handling several openings at once
  • Batch / passing year: Not stated
  • CGPA cut-off: Not stated

Unconfirmed: the listing does not say whether final-year MBA students can join or only graduates. If you are still studying, confirm this with the recruiter on the call.

Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 expected salary

Official: the Naukri listing shows ₹3–4 LPA and does not split internship pay from post-conversion pay. Reported: AmbitionBox shows ₹1.4–8 LPA for Info Edge interns across all roles, based on only four reports, so use it as a loose guide. Info Edge talent acquisition staff with 2–6 years of experience report roughly ₹2.3–9.1 LPA on the same site.

Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 selection process

For the Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026, the company has not published the interview rounds. Based on how most recruitment internships are filled, plan for these steps:

  1. Submit the Google Form, then join the Google Meet for the direct interview
  2. A short HR chat about your background and why you want recruitment work
  3. A role-play or mock screening call to test how you speak to candidates
  4. A final talk with the hiring manager about targets and the internship terms

How to apply for Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026

  1. Fill in the Info Edge Google Form to register for the drive
  2. Attend the Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026 direct interview online and answer the recruiter’s questions on camera
  3. See the original listing on Naukri (job ID 231126010757); the contact person named there is Aashi Bhulwal

Never pay any fee to attend. Info Edge and Naukri do not charge candidates for interviews.

About Info Edge

Info Edge (India) Ltd is an Indian internet company with its corporate office in Noida. It runs Naukri.com, 99acres, Jeevansathi and Shiksha, and it is listed on the NSE and BSE. Through drives such as the Info Edge Virtual Drive 2026, its HR teams hire in large numbers for sales and support roles across these businesses, which is why this internship centres on high-volume non-IT hiring.
